name: DecalVertex
src_typeComment: One clipped-polygon vertex, carried through Sutherland-Hodgman clipping. `position` is in DECAL-LOCAL space (the projection box normalized to the [-0.5, 0.5] unit cube); `normal` is WORLD space, kept for per-vertex lighting/orientation on the final mesh — interpolated at clip points the same way position is, so a decal wrapping a curved surface shades smoothly instead of faceted per source triangle.
